title: Data provider: Stooq (fallback)
description: Implement StooqProvider (app/data/stooq_provider.py) as the fallback market data source when yfinance fails or rate-limits, satisfying the same DataProvider protocol.

checklist.step: Implement get_daily_ohlcv(ticker) using Stooq's CSV endpoint, returning the same column shape as YFinanceProvider
Implement get_weekly_ohlcv(ticker) — resample daily bars to weekly since Stooq has no native weekly interval
Handle unknown ticker / insufficient history the same way as data-provider-yfinance (typed exceptions -> 404 / 422)
Write unit tests against recorded CSV fixtures — no live network calls
Confirm StooqProvider and YFinanceProvider are interchangeable behind the DataProvider protocol (shared contract test)
Run pytest --cov=app --cov-report=term-missing and confirm no regression
